title: BEACON Data Catalog source
description: What one source of data offers, one dataset per entry: catalog/<source>.yaml. A source is anywhere BEACON could read data from: a data service (GDEX), an open-data program (NOAA's NODD, ECMWF open data) or a local collection (on GLADE or another disk). The file is generated (gdex-index for GDEX) or hand-written. Entries are candidates: a dataset is usable in cases once it has a record in datasets/.

id.description: Must match the file name without .yaml.

name.description: Short name for tables, e.g. GDEX.

dataset_url.description: An entry's landing page; {id} is replaced by the entry's id.

listing.description: Where the list of datasets was read from.

locations.description: Where every entry's files are, {id} replaced by the entry's id. An entry with its own locations uses those instead.

identifier_scheme.description: The identifiers scheme (dataset.schema.json) by which a record in datasets/ names one of this source's entries, e.g. gdex. The catalog then links records and entries itself; without one, entries say which records use them in beacon.

refresh.description: The command that regenerates the file. Leave out for a hand-written file.

retrieved.description: When the list was read from the source, or last checked by hand (UTC).

counts.description: Written by a generator: how many datasets the source publishes, and how many it left out and why. The catalog counts the entries itself.

left_out.description: Reason (kind <kind> or type <type>) to number of datasets.

access.description: As in dataset records: posix (a file system, e.g. GLADE), https, s3 or globus.

id.description: The source's own ID for the dataset.

kind.description: What the dataset is. For generated files this may be a guess; the source's notes say how it was made.

updates.description: How often the source adds data, e.g. daily; left out when it no longer does.

variables.description: The kinds of variable BEACON compares that the dataset has. Coarse: no levels.

access.description: open, or terms when the source states conditions of use (quoted in terms).

beacon.description: The records in datasets/ that use this dataset.

type.description: The source's own status for the dataset when it isn't current, e.g. GDEX's historical.

url.description: Landing page, when the source's dataset_url doesn't give it.
